decisive_items: diffuse contraction band necrosis with several lymphocytes in cardiac muscle
SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab
response.rationale: R6 uniquely combines COVID-19 exposure, positive antigen, cardiac injury markers, and histologic myocarditis with no coronary obstruction, fitting COVID-19 myocarditis. R1 is similar but lacks exposure context and is less specific.

rejected.why: Thrombopenia and contraction band necrosis are nonspecific; no schistocytes or renal involvement
Thrombopenia alone insufficient; no fibrin thrombi or coagulopathy evidence
Contradicted by absence of respiratory symptoms; pulmonary findings are secondary
Less complete than R6; lacks exposure and no-coronary-artery evidence
Explicitly contradicted by no coronary stenosis
Only thrombopenia; no microangiopathic hemolytic anemia or neurologic signs
No supporting spans; infarction not supported
Pericardial effusion present but myocardial necrosis and COVID-19 point to myocarditis
Too broad; specific viral myocarditis is more accurate
